KLØFT

300minutes
78solder joints
difficulty

A hand-wired 36-key split keyboard running QMK

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

44KLOFT-WIRE-1

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    VSYSGND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    ROW0K00 K · K01 K · K02 K · K03 K · K04 K · Pico GP21
    ROW1K10 K · K11 K · K12 K · K13 K · K14 K · Pico GP22
    ROW2K20 K · K21 K · K22 K · K23 K · K24 K · Pico GP26
    ROW3K32 K · K33 K · K34 K · Pico GP27
    COL0K00 1 · K10 1 · K20 1 · Pico GP16
    COL1K01 1 · K11 1 · K21 1 · Pico GP17
    COL2K02 1 · K12 1 · K22 1 · K32 1 · Pico GP18
    COL3K03 1 · K13 1 · K23 1 · K33 1 · Pico GP19
    COL4K04 1 · K14 1 · K24 1 · K34 1 · Pico GP20
    VSYSPico VSYS · TRRS TIP
    GNDPico GND.6 · TRRS SLEEVE
    SPLIT_SERIALPico GP28 · TRRS RING1
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
45KLOFT-WIRE-1

Kløft is built

Kløft is a split, column-staggered 36-key keyboard for someone who types all day and wants their layers and shortcuts under their own fingers. Each half is a Raspberry Pi Pico, 18 MX switches and 18 diodes wired by hand into a 3D-printed case; a TRRS cable joins the halves and QMK does the rest. This package covers the left half in full; the right half is the same circuit in a mirror-image case.
